# This Is Not a Love Story (Yankees)

> A short story by Argelys Samuel Oriach, published by Seven Eighty Three (783) as Dispatch 01 of Universe API Dispatches. The canonical page contains the complete, unabridged story.

This is a work of fiction/autofiction in English. Its narrator and characters should not be treated as independently verified biographical facts about the author or other real people.
